heroText: Discover carefully curated community creations for Aerofly Flight Simulator. Aircraft enhancements, custom liveries, detailed scenery and more.
categoriesDescription: From aircraft modifications to immersive destinations, explore content created to make your simulator feel like your own.
featuredText: Have a project in mind, spotted something that needs improving, or created an add-on of your own? We want to hear from you.
aboutText: AR Flight Studios is an independent community project focused on sharing creative add-ons and enhancements for Aerofly Flight Simulator. Our goal is simple: bring creators and flight simulation enthusiasts together.
discordText: Join our Discord community for release announcements, support, feedback and conversations with fellow sim pilots.
footerDescription: Enhancing your Aerofly experience, one community project at a time.
